# Fix It Jerry

> Fix It Jerry is a device repair shop in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia with four branches
> (Desa Parkcity, Subang Jaya, Bukit Jalil, Puchong). We repair smartphones, tablets,
> laptops, Nintendo Switch, AirPods, and Apple Watches with transparent MYR pricing.
> Repairs start from RM 80 with most screen and battery replacements completed same-day.
>
> Brands serviced: Apple (iPhone, iPad, MacBook, Apple Watch, AirPods), Samsung, Google Pixel,
> Huawei, Xiaomi, OPPO, Vivo, OnePlus, Lenovo, Asus, Acer, Dell, HP, Nintendo Switch.
>
> Repair types: Screen replacement, battery replacement, charging port repair, water damage
> recovery, data recovery, RAM/SSD upgrade, GPU repair, motherboard repair, software issues.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.fixitjerry.com/): Overview of services, locations, and pricing range (RM 80–1,200).
- [Contact & Locations](https://www.fixitjerry.com/contact): Full addresses, per-branch contacts, and operating hours.
- [Book a Repair](https://www.fixitjerry.com/book-a-repair): Online booking form.

## Service Areas
- [All Repair Areas](https://www.fixitjerry.com/phone-repair): 44 areas across KL, PJ and Selangor with same-day courier pickup — including condo-level coverage in Desa ParkCity (Westside I–III, The Breezeway, Northshore Gardens, Nadia Parkfront, South Brooks, One Central Park, Sofiya Residensi, Park Place, Park Regent, Noora).
- [Phone Repair Mont Kiara](https://www.fixitjerry.com/phone-repair/mont-kiara): Pickup around Plaza Mont Kiara and Solaris.
- [Phone Repair Bangsar](https://www.fixitjerry.com/phone-repair/bangsar): Pickup around Bangsar Village and Telawi.
- [Phone Repair Desa ParkCity](https://www.fixitjerry.com/phone-repair/desa-parkcity): Walk-in branch inside the township.
- [Phone Repair Subang Jaya](https://www.fixitjerry.com/phone-repair/subang-jaya): SS15 branch, walk-ins welcome.
